newsitem.title: UK: Erratic Nyk futures put Liverpool cotton on hold.
newsitem.headline: Erratic Nyk futures put Liverpool cotton on hold.

text.p: Erratic New York futures tended to undermine buying interest in raw cotton.
Although the downturn in futures on Tuesday resulted in slightly more attractive offers from certain origins, spinners are mostly of the view that prices may fall further.
They are unwilling to cover more than pressing requirements.

Trade seers are reluctant to discount prices more sharply, since in several important producing countries the crop outlook, for quality and quantity, remains uncertain. So business concluded was restricted and mostly confined to shipments either side of the year-end.
